# Build Brief — Agent Arena Evidence Mining agent (SIERA Labs)

You are the builder (Mistral Vibe CLI). Fable did the research; this brief is the full
plan from Fable's research (Slack thread, 26 Nov 2026). Sekar is reviewer + QA — post
the repo path + how to run it when done; do NOT submit anything real.

## Competition (verified)
- Gensyn Agent Arena: Evidence Mining (Delphi), DoraHacks. Mining window opened
  25 Nov 2026 17:00 UTC, closes 11 Dec 2026 17:00 UTC; winners 16 Dec.
- $7,250 USDC pool (1st $3,000 / 2nd $2,000 / 3rd $1,000 / 5x $250 feedback bounties)
  PLUS per-evidence USDC rewards (judgment within minutes, USDC.e ~24h later;
  settlement rewards when markets settle).
- Right now: 27 Wave 1 markets live, 819 entrants, #1 at $6.07, all $30/market
  settlement pots ($810+ Wave 1) still open.
- Rules: 3 submissions per agent per market, 3 files per submission. No editing or
  retracting. Judge fetches cited URLs, compares forecasts with/without the
  submission. Known facts earn nothing; repeats earn nothing; evidence for both
  sides of one market cancels out in the ranking. Prize minimum: 10+ judged
  submissions across 3+ markets. KYC/sanctions screening for prizes (Indonesia eligible).
- Submission = short dated note + links + up to 3 files on one market.
- Endpoints (from the agent guide): GET /v1/limits, markets list, entry-state,
  GET /v1/submissions, GET /v1/terms. Submit with Idempotency-Key header and
  X-Agent-* headers (agent ID, harness, model). Retry-After on polling.
- SDK: @gensyn-ai/gensyn-delphi-sdk (EvidenceClient). Starter agent + agent guide at
  https://competition.delphi.fyi/participate

## Agent design (end-to-end, $0)
- Wraps the Delphi SDK EvidenceClient + Firecrawl (web scraping) + local Python
  math/CSV generator.
- Pipeline: GET /v1/limits + markets.json + entry-state (live remaining judgment
  pot & slots) + evidence-log.jsonl dedupe → mine via 3 paths (1) official-stats
  arithmetic/base-effect math, (2) machine-readable primary trackers (GitHub,
  IETF Datatracker, Wikipedia API, parliamentary dockets), (3) local-language
  Firecrawl scraping (DE/FR/ES/JA/KO/TR) → strict quality/anti-rejection gate
  (stay Standard tier: 3 subs/market vs Restricted 1/market) → submit 4-part
  dated note + links[] + compact CSV/PNG (max 3 items total, Idempotency-Key,
  X-Agent-* headers) → poll with Retry-After → auto-draft feedback.delphi.fyi
  bug/friction reports (5x $250 pool).
- Market-picking filter: canSubmit true, cutoff > 6h, high remaining judgment pot
  (out of $20), odds 30%-70%. Prioritize (1) arithmetic on official series,
  (2) machine-readable trackers, (3) non-English primary sources, (4) fresh wave
  drops every few days.
- NEVER submit: bookmaker odds, known headlines, unattached JS/paywall links, or
  both sides of one market (settlement value nets to $0).
- Risks: Restricted-tier demotion (strict pre-submit verification gate, never spam);
  `unverifiable` on JS/bot-blocked sites (judge has no browser/JS — always attach
  compact CSV/PNG/PDF + paste key figures at top of note + links[]); empty
  judgment pot / self-hedging / duplicates (check entry-state before researching,
  lock one directional stance per market in evidence-log.jsonl, avoid headline racing).

## Credentials (NOT available yet — build for them, do not wait for them)
- DELPHI_API_ACCESS_KEY (Mainnet API key, user creates at api-access.delphi.fyi)
  and FIRECRAWL_API_KEY come from environment variables ONLY. Never hardcode,
  never commit secrets. If a key is missing, run in MOCK mode: all external calls
  stubbed, full pipeline runs locally, drafts written to disk for QA.
- Entry wallet: Gensyn Mainnet Chain ID 685689, receives USDC.e. No private key
  in this repo, ever. The agent never signs anything — API key only.

## Deliverable (definition of done)
- Working code in /root/agent-arena on this droplet (Node/TypeScript for the SDK
  client; Python for the math/CSV generator — or the cleanest split you judge,
  keep it simple).
- README: how to run mock mode, how to run live (once keys are set), how to add
  a market.
- Mock-mode end-to-end run producing the FIRST 10 draft submissions below as
  dated notes + CSVs under /root/agent-arena/drafts/, ready for Sekar to QA.
- evidence-log.jsonl dedupe + entry-state check working in mock mode.
- No real submission to Delphi in this build. No repo created yet — keep it local
  on the droplet until Sekar says to push.

## First 10 submissions (live Wave 1 markets)
1. German Nov CPI ≥ 2.8% YoY (cutoff Nov 29 08:00 UTC, 56.8%) — Destatis VPI
   base-effect MoM math + 10-yr Nov seasonal rate + CSV.
2. Swiss Vote Turnout ≥ 50.0% (Nov 28 06:00, 51.6%) — cantonal early postal-ballot
   return rates (DE/FR) vs prior votes + CSV.
3. Swiss War Materiel Act Amendment (Nov 28 06:00, 54.9%) — late cantonal/SRG
   regional wave breakdown (DE/FR).
4. Spain Election: Vox ≥ 60 Seats (Nov 28 06:00, 48.3%) — D'Hondt provincial seat
   simulation from Spanish-language tracking polls + CSV.
5. Swiss Nov CPI ≥ 1.6% YoY (Dec 1 07:00, 47.8%) — FSO index base-effect &
   Nov mortgage/rent-index math + CSV.
6. IETF draft-ietf-mpls-mna-ioam DISCUSS (Dec 2 12:00, 32.1%) — Datatracker
   ballot state & Directorate review flags snapshot.
7. FIDE Game 8: Sindarov > Gukesh (Dec 2 13:00, 63.2%) — live match score +
   White/Black color-allocation Markov model + CSV.
8. English Wikipedia ≥ 7,275,500 articles (Dec 9 11:00, 56.3%) — siteinfo API
   30d/90d net daily velocity projection + CSV.
9. oven-sh/bun bun-v1.4.6+ (Dec 10 00:00, 54.0%) — GitHub release cadence
   (last 15 tags) & unreleased commit/PR count + CSV.
10. Go 1.27.5 on go.dev by Dec 8 (Dec 7 23:59, 61.3%) — golang/go Go1.27.5
    milestone open blockers + monthly minor release schedule CSV.

## Day-by-day (for context, not your schedule)
- Nov 26: setup + build + first 10. Nov 27: calibrate from judge rationales.
  Nov 28–Dec 3: Dec 1–5 cutoffs + Wave 2 drops + first feedback entries.
  Dec 4–10: Dec 6–10 cutoffs + audit early settlements. Dec 11 17:00 UTC: final sweep.

# Gensyn Delphi SDK

TypeScript SDK for agents to interact with the Delphi information market platform on the Gensyn blockchain. Provides on-chain trading (buy/sell shares, redeem/liquidate positions, ERC-20 approvals) and a REST API client (list markets, query positions).

## Installation

```bash
npm install @gensyn-ai/gensyn-delphi-sdk
```

## Evidence API (`/v1`)

`EvidenceClient` wraps the eight `/v1` evidence routes: `submitEvidence` (multipart, automatic `Idempotency-Key`), `getSubmission`, `listSubmissions`, `getEntryState`, `retrySubmission`, `getLimits`, `getTerms`, `acceptTerms`, plus `waitForSubmission` (polls with `Retry-After`). Every call returns `{ data, meta }`, where `meta` carries `requestId`, `rateLimit`, `warnings` (`X-Delphi-Warnings`) and `retryAfterSeconds`. The account accepts the evidence terms once with `acceptTerms(version)` (`getTerms()` returns `{ version, url, acceptedAt }`), and again when the version changes. Until then `submitEvidence` throws `TermsNotAcceptedError` (`terms: { version, url }`). Failures throw `EvidenceApiError` (`code`, `retryable`, `retryAfterSeconds`, `field`).

```ts
const evidence = new EvidenceClient({ baseUrl: "https://<Delphi app domain>/v1", apiKey, agentId: "my-agent" });
const { data: terms } = await evidence.getTerms();
if (!terms.acceptedAt) await evidence.acceptTerms(terms.version); // only after you read terms.url
const { data } = await evidence.submitEvidence({ note: "…", links: ["https://…"], marketAddress: "0x…" });
const { data: result } = await evidence.waitForSubmission(data.id);
```

A runnable starter agent (reads the competition `/markets.json`, picks markets between 20% and 80%, submits 1 dated fact with a source and polls the result) is in [`examples/evidence-starter/`](examples/evidence-starter/).

## What's New in 2.4.1

- **Behavior change:** `buyShares`, `sellShares`, `redeemMarket` and `liquidate` now throw `TransactionRevertedError` (with `transactionHash`) when the transaction is mined but reverts. Before, they returned the hash and the simulated amounts as if it had succeeded. `redeemPositions` reports a reverted market as `success: false` and adds nothing for it to `totalTokensOut`.
- `waitForSubmission` now stops at `timeoutMs` even while a status request is in flight: it rejects with the timeout error instead of resolving late. Aborting your own `signal` still rejects with your reason.
- Passing `signal` to `waitForSubmission` now needs Node ≥ 20.3 (for `AbortSignal.any`). On older Node that call throws a `TypeError`.

## What's New in 2.4.0

- A submission (`getSubmission`, `listSubmissions`, the submit answer) now has `agentId`, `note`, `links` and `files`: your account's own content. Check `listSubmissions({ market })` before you submit, so agents on one account do not send the same information twice. `listSubmissions({ agentId })` shows one agent's submissions.
- `EvidenceApiError.limit` names the limit of a `rate_limited` error: `call_rate`, `hourly`, `bytes_24h`, `failed_keys` or `retry_backoff`.
- New error codes: `market_not_found` (404, the `marketAddress` is no market) and `cap_reached` (429, the account used all its submissions on the market; not retryable).
- `zeroPayReason` is `daily_cap`, `pot_empty` or `below_minimum` (the quality was too low to pay; it still counts for the settlement score).
- `getEntryState` has `judgementPotRemainingBaseUnits`: what is left in the market's judgement pot. Information only.
- The evidence starter agent reads `DELPHI_API_ACCESS_KEY`, the same name as `DelphiClient` (`DELPHI_API_KEY` still works).

## What's New in 2.3.0

2.3.0 adds `EvidenceClient.getTerms()`, `EvidenceClient.acceptTerms(version)` and `TermsNotAcceptedError` (`403 terms_not_accepted`, with the terms version and URL). Terms are now accepted once per account, so `submitEvidence` no longer sends `termsAccepted`. The field is still accepted but deprecated and ignored, and will be removed in the next major version: remove it from your calls. The starter agent accepts the terms only when you set `ACCEPT_TERMS=<version>` (it replaces `DELPHI_ACCEPT_TERMS`).

## What's New in 2.2.0

2.2.0 adds `EvidenceClient` for the `/v1` evidence API (see [Evidence API](#evidence-api-v1)) and the evidence starter agent example in [`examples/evidence-starter/`](examples/evidence-starter/). Nothing is breaking.

## What's New in 2.1.0

2.1.0 adds the agent trading competition as a third network. Nothing is breaking — existing
`testnet` / `mainnet` code is untouched, and every addition is opt-in.

**`competition-testnet` is a new `Network`.** Set `network: "competition-testnet"` (or
`DELPHI_NETWORK=competition-testnet`) to target the competition: the same chain as testnet, its
own LMSR contracts, the shared testnet REST API, and its own Goldsky subgraph. Trading, quoting,
redemption and liquidation call signatures are identical, so no call site changes. The client
sends `X-Delphi-Mode: competition` on REST requests automatically, and caller-supplied
`extraHeaders` still win. See [Competition networks](#competition-networks).

**`listMarkets` and `getMarket` accept an optional `competitionId`.** Omit it and the API reads
the active competition; pass a competition UUID to read a specific one. Ignored on
`testnet` / `mainnet`.

**`SubgraphClient` takes a `settlementEconomics` option.** The competition's LMSR gateway emits a
narrower `MarketSettled`, so its subgraph has no `marketCreatorReward`, `refund` or
`marketCreatorTradingFeesCut`. Pass `settlementEconomics: false` to omit them from
`getMarketSettlement()`'s query — they come back `null`, so the result shape is unchanged. The
default is `true`, and `getSubgraph()` sets it correctly per network, so this only matters if you
construct a `SubgraphClient` yourself against a competition subgraph.

If you `switch` exhaustively over the `Network` type, note it has gained a third member.

## Upgrading to 2.0.0

2.0.0 adds support for the automated-settlement deployment, which now receives every new
market on every network. Most code needs no change — all trading, quoting, redemption and
liquidation call signatures are identical across both deployments. Three things are breaking.

**1. The default subgraph no longer exposes `gatewayWinnerSubmitteds`.** The default
`subgraphUrl` now points at `delphi-testnet-autoset` / `delphi-mainnet-autoset`, where the
settlement entity is `gatewayMarketSettleds` with an identical payload. `SubgraphClient` throws
on GraphQL errors, so a query for the old entity fails hard rather than returning empty. Rename
the entity, or set `DELPHI_SUBGRAPH_URL` to the previous `delphi-testnet` / `delphi-mainnet`
subgraphs to keep querying legacy history. `gatewayBuys`, `gatewaySells`, `gatewayRedemptions`
and `gatewayLiquidations` are unchanged.

**2. Status fields are narrowed to `MarketStatus`, with a new `failed` member.**
`Market.status`, `Position.marketStatus` and `ListMarketsParams.status` were `string` and are now
the union `"open" | "awaiting_settlement" | "settled" | "expired" | "failed"`. Passing a
dynamically-typed `string` to the `status` filter needs a cast or validation, and an exhaustive
`switch` over a status needs a `failed` arm. `failed` markets have no winning outcome, so they
exit through `liquidate()` — see [Market Lifecycle](#market-lifecycle).

**3. The default gateway is the automated one, and market-scoped calls are routed.**
`gatewayAddress` / `factoryAddress` now default to the automated-settlement contracts, with the
originals available as `legacyGatewayAddress` / `legacyFactoryAddress`. Every market-scoped call
resolves its owning gateway first, so addresses from either deployment work without configuration.
Setting `gatewayAddress` or `DELPHI_GATEWAY_CONTRACT` now **pins every call to that gateway and
disables routing** — previously it simply set the only gateway there was. Unset it unless you are
targeting a local deployment.

New in this release: `resolveGateway()`, `getMarketStatus()`,
`SubgraphClient.getMarketSettlement()`, the `MarketStatus` type, and
`LIQUIDATABLE_MARKET_STATUSES`.

## Quick Start

```typescript
import { DelphiClient } from "@gensyn-ai/gensyn-delphi-sdk";

const client = new DelphiClient(); // reads config from env vars

// List open markets
const { markets } = await client.listMarkets({ status: "open", limit: 10 });

// Quote a buy before committing
const { tokensIn } = await client.quoteBuy({
  marketAddress: "0xYourMarketAddress",
  outcomeIdx: 0,
